meta_description:
627 likes, 21 comments - siddharthajoshi on October 3, 2026: "My first time here, and I ended up in one of its most rugged, breathtaking, and lesser-explored regions: Dagestan! 

From the moment I landed, @uaz.family handled the entire journey seamlessly - from sorting my e-visa and e-SIM to connecting me with amazing local English-speaking groups in Makhachkala, where I got a front-row seat to the city’s unique history, and it’s insane MMA culture.

Next we spent 5 days hiking high through the Caucasus Mountains - staying at three distinct, pristine campsites (ridge views, alpine plateaus, and river valleys), enjoying gourmet campsite meals by our chef Mohamad, taking hot showers in the wild, and bonding late into the night over delicious local wine and games.

Then came the ultimate highlight: Andreas trusted me with the keys to an iconic Soviet 4×4 UAZ for a multi-day self-driving adventure! Navigating mountain passes, experiencing the legendary hospitality of mountain villages, and camping out solo under the glowing Milky Way was pure magic.

This was truly an adventure of a lifetime. Stay tuned - I’ll be sharing the full story, breakdowns, and all the details of what happened on this wild ride very soon! 🏔️🚘✨

#Dagestan #UAZFamily #Caucasus #uaz".
